source.checkpoint: SW0097 seed0 positive_frozen core and registered encoder
source.training_ids: the same registered 4096 ordered TRAIN IDs used by SW0097

features.flattening: per patch, component-major then settled-time, producing 128 channels
features.normalization: one fixed per-channel RMS fitted from the first 32 ordered B16 TRAIN batches (512 images), using frozen SW0097 seed0 source and original encoder; values <=1e-8 use neutral denominator 1.0; frozen through warmup and joint training; no ground-truth input
features.head: shared Linear(128,64), GELU, Linear(64,11), softmax(logits/0.1)
features.count_constraint: none; no occupancy uniformity or count loss

auxiliary_objective.rgb_target: detached native RGB patch means X [B,256,3]
auxiliary_objective.reconstruction: per image: variance=mean_channel(var_over_256_patches(X)); R=mean((P mu-X)^2)/clamp_min(variance,1e-6); batch R is mean over images
auxiliary_objective.candidate_total: old phase objective + 5*old actual-positive-Q objective + lambda*(R+C)
auxiliary_objective.readout: unchanged legacy actual-spike Q threshold/component evaluator; assignment head is discarded

schedule.head_warmup: 32 ordered TRAIN batches of 16 images (512 images); source core, encoder, and graph frozen; head-only Adam at 3e-4 on unweighted R with clip 1; retain this head optimizer state for joint training
schedule.joint_training: 256 updates, B=16, T=64, settle=32; original 4096-ID order and registered shuffle seed 117
schedule.joint_optimizer: fresh core/graph/encoder Adam (core/graph LR 3e-5, encoder LR 3e-6) on old+lambda*(R+C), clip core families together at 1; separate retained head Adam LR 3e-4 on unweighted R only, clip head gradients at 1
schedule.loss_weight: seed0 lambda=0.25*median(first-four TRAIN batch ||grad(old)|| / ||grad(R+C)||); fixed for all later batches/seeds; require finite and 1e-4<=lambda<=1e4, otherwise stop without clamping or retuning

preflight: all four calibration batches have finite, nonzero old and auxiliary gradients in encoder, graph, and non-graph core families
head R is below the global-mean RGB baseline
fixed row scrambling increases reconstruction error
R gives finite nonzero gradients to head parameters and C gives finite nonzero gradients to Q-producing parameters
R also has finite nonzero direct gradient to actual component spike traces; assignment probabilities vary across patches
one throwaway full optimizer update is finite and changes expected trainable parameters

promotion.candidate_mean_fg_ari: at least +0.01 over both frozen SW0097 seed0 and matched control
promotion.paired_image_bootstrap: 95% lower bound greater than zero against both references
promotion.both_iou_metrics: foreground IoU and matched-object IoU each exceed their registered Slot mean by more than 0.05
promotion.failure_policy: no tuning or seed expansion after a failed registered guard
